rules.accepted_credit_types: ACPE-accredited providers, programs approved by the Board or other state boards of pharmacy, and Board pharmacy law programs
rules.new_licensee_rule: Pharmacists granted initial New Mexico licensure are exempt; the initial license runs at least 24 months to the end of the birth month.
rules.audit_note: At least 10% of registrants randomly audited each year; insufficient CPE means a fine of at least $1000 and make-up CPE.

topics.who: Patient safety as applicable to pharmacy practice
Pharmacy law program offered by the NM Board (non-resident, non-practicing pharmacists may use an ACPE law course)
Safe and appropriate use of opioids; one 2-hour program covering both patient safety and opioids satisfies both

rules.notes: At least 1.0 CEU (10 contact hours), excluding the law requirement, must be live programs approved by ACPE or ACCME. Renewal period ends the last day of the birth month every 2 years.
